newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Feb 24 - Durres - Six vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 ferro chrome, 1 chrome ore, 1 general cargo in containers). 3 Discharging (1 general cargo, 1 bagged cement, 1 wheat flour). 5 Vessels awaiting berths all to discharge, of which 1 bagged rice, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged flour, 1 bagged wheat flour, 1 general cargo.

BULGARIA, Feb 17-23 - Bourgas - 18 Vessels in port operating of which 12 loading (6 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 baryte concentrates, 3 steel, 1 gasoil). 2 Discharging (1 coal, 1 iron ore). 3 Discharging/loading (1 containers,general cargo, 1 tobacco/fertiliser, 1 pipes/general cargo), 1 empty vessel. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 benzene, 1 chemicals, 1 general cargo), 1 to discharge coal, 1 to discharge/load sugar/metals, 1 to discharge/load containers, 1 empty, 1 awaiting orders. 13 Vessels due of which 9 to load (1 copper, 1 plates, 2 fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 steel, 1 coke, 1 metal), 1 to discharge sugar, 3 to discharge/load containers.

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 30 Vessels in port operating of which 24 loading (1 cigarettes, 5 soda, 1 cement, 2 glass, 3 sas, 1 kaolin, 3 clinker, 2 quartz sand, 1 scrap, 3 fertiliser, 2 tsp). 1 Discharging coal, 1 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 4 discharging/loading containers. 11 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 cement, 1 soda, 1 quartz sand, 1 glass, 1 sas). 1 To discharge cotton, 1 under repairs, 4 cargo not nominated.

Feb 24 - Varna - No labour problems. Varna east - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 awaiting orders. Varna west - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna lesport, Tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No labour problems. Bourgas east - 10 Vessels loading at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 13 due. Bourgas west - 5 Vessels loading at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel loading at berth.

CROATIA, Feb 24 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth, 3 at inoperative berth, 6 under repair/dry-docked, 8 vessels due with delays expected. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Ploce - Two vessels discharging. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Split, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Feb 25 - Limassol - Six container vessels loading/discharging at berth, 5 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 7 Vessels due 26/2 of which 3 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 3 passenger vessels. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, Feb 25 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 4 Map vessels loading at berth, 1 liner, 5 vessels due. No delays expected. Kopli - 1 Sawn timber vessel loading at berth, 4 vessels due, no delays. Parnu - Four vessels loading at berth (1 briquettes, 1 peat, 2 timber), 3 vessels due.

ITALY, Feb 25 - Naples - One container vessel etb 25/2. Gaeta - One bulk carrier etb 26/2. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 2 Vessels in roads, no delays. 42 Vessels berthed, 3 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - One vessel in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, no delays, 39 vessels berthed.

Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, no vessels berthed. Sarroch - Four vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto - Five vessels in roads. Ravenna - Seven vessels in roads. Venice - No vessels in roads. Trieste - One vessel in roads.

LATVIA Feb 25 - No strikes in any port. Ventspils - Five vessels in port of which 3 operating as follows, 1 ferrous metal loader, 1 banana discharger, 1 fish discharger. 2 Vessels waiting, no delays, 11 due. Riga - 10 Vessels in port, all operating, of which 3 timber loaders, 1 sunflower seed loader, 2 container loaders, 1 scrap metal loader, 1 wheat discharger, 1 tanker discharger, 1 fish discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 14 due. Liepaja - Seven vessels in port of which 5 operating, 2 waiting, no delays, 5 due.

LITHUANIA, Feb 24 - Klaipeda - 13 Vessels loading (1 oil, 5 fertiliser, 1 metal, 2 timber, 1 cement, 1 ingots, 1 steel coils, 1 steel frameworks). 11 Discharging (3 fish, 3 bananas, 1 corn, 1 soya pellets, 2 sugar, 1 sub products). 3 Loading/discharging, 7 vessels in roads, 30 due.

POLAND, Feb 25 - Szczecin - 48 Vessels loading at berth, 42 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 8 under repair/dry-docked, 88 due. Gdynia - Nine vessels operating of which 5 general cargo loading at berth. 4 Vessels discharging at berth (3 general cargo, 1 bulker), 5 under repair/dry-docked, 30 due. Gdansk - 12 vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (3 bulkers, 4 grain, 2 general cargo). 3 Discharging at berth (1 bulker, 1 tanker, 1 grain). 3 Vessels under repair-dry-docked, 1 tanker awaiting turn, 27 vessels due.

PORTUGAL, Feb 24 - Leixoes - 12 Vessels operating of which 8 general cargo, 4 containers, 1 handy-size container vessel totalling 6,500 dwt awaiting berth, vacant places. 7 Piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. Sines - Two vessels in port operating of which 1 loading gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel, 1 loading fuel oil, 1 waiting to load propane. 5 Vessels due of which 2 to discharge (1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha). 3 To load (1 aromatic mixture, 1 propylene, 1 unleaded gasoline).

Lisbon - 58 Vessels in port of which 1 loading at berth, 15 discharging at berth, 3 loading/discharging at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 13 under repair/dry-docked, 7 awaiting orders. 18 Miscellaneous craft, 15 vessels due. Setubal - Feb 25 - Two vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked, 12 due of which 8 to discharge, 3 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Feb 24 - Constantza - 34 Vessels operating of which 18 general cargo (16 loading, 2 discharging). 5 Bulkers (3 loading, 2 discharging), 6 bagged chemicals, 3 bagged cement (all loading). 2 Tankers (1 loading, 1 discharging). 4 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load (1 general cargo, 1 bagged cement). 2 Tankers loading/discharging. Constantza south (Agigea) - 2 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - Five livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - Feb 24 - 24 Vessels operating of which 15 loading (6 non-ferrous metals, 1 scrap, 2 containers, 3 fertiliser, 1 cellulose, 1 general cargo, 1 coal). 9 Discharging (2 bagged rice, 1 frozen meat, 3 containers, 1 bananas, 1 milk powder, 1 fertiliser). 12 Vessels waiting, 11 due. Feb 25 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - Six vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 coal loader, 1 timber loader, 1 flour discharger, 1 feed discharger, 1 container discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 2 due. Vyborg - Two vessels in port, both waiting due to ice, 1 due.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - Feb 24 - 19 Vessels in port operating of which 12 loading (5 steel, 1 scrap, 1 aluminium, 2 saltpetre, 1 coal, 1 fertiliser, 1 molasses). 7 Discharging (1 rice, 1 sugar, 1 aluminium, 1 bananas, 3 various). 20 Vessels waiting in roads of which 14 to load (7 steel, 2 copper, 1 aluminium, 1 coal, 2 scrap, 1 cellulose). 6 To discharge (1 sugar, 3 rice, 1 rice/oranges, 1 citrus). 45 Vessels due of which 30 to load (1 cement, 5 scrap, 13 steel, 2 copper, 3 aluminium, 2 zinc, 1 lead/zinc, 1 phosphates, 1 cellulose, 1 vegetable oil). 13 To discharge (5 sugar, 1 rice, 1 citrus, 1 equipment, 1 pipes, 2 cars, 2 luggage). 4 To discharge,load containers. Oil terminal - 25/2 - 3 Tankers berthed of which 1 tanker loading crude oil, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil. 3 Tankers due to load of which 1 crude oil, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil.

FAR EASTERN PORTS - Feb 25 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - 17 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (4 metal, 3 timber). 2 Containers discharging/loading, 2 passenger vessels, 6 waiting. Nakhodka - 13 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (4 metal, 4 timber), 5 waiting. Vostochny - 11 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (2 timber, 2 metal, 2 coal), 1 discharging/loading containers, 4 waiting. Posyet - No vessels. Zarubino - No vessels.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Feb 25 - 10 Vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 2 npk, 1 apatite, 2 cabotage, 1 steel, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 alumina discharger, 3 apatite loaders waiting. 12 Vessels due during the week of which 7 loaders (3 apatite, 1 scrap, 2 cabotage, 1 iron ore pellets). 5 Dischargers (3 alumina, 2 general cargo).

SLOVENIA, Feb 24 - Koper - 11 Vessels berthed of which 1 ferry loading/discharging. 5 Discharging (2 alumina/coal, 1 gasoline, 1 chemicals, 1 oranges). 5 Loading (1 coal, 3 steel products/sawn timber, 1 bulls). 13 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 5 to load/discharge containers, 1 ferry to load/discharge, 2 car carriers to load/discharge cars. 3 Vessels to discharge (1 gasoline, 2 coal/sulphur). 2 Vessels to load sawn timber/steel products. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Feb 24 - Bilbao - 19 Vessels operating of which 7 discharging, 6 loading, 6 loading/discharging, no delays. Feb 25 - No delays/congestion/strikes. Aviles - Seven vessels in port of which 1 discharging coal. 6 Loading (4 steel, 1 tar, 1 structures). Gijon - Four vessels in port of which 2 loading (1 sugar, 1 cement). 2 Discharging (1 coal, 1 fuel oil).

Cadiz - 13 Vessels operating of which 4 ro-ros, 4 under repair, 1 semolina, 2 ship building materials, 1 sand, 1 cotton, no delays. Sagunto - 22 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ros discharging/loading general cargo, 1 vessel discharging/loading containers. 7 Vessels loading (3 fertiliser, 1 cement, 3 steel products). 11 Discharging (2 logs,timber, 9 steel products), no vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.
Feb 26 - Santander - Nine vessel operating of which 3 loading (1 sugar, 1 cement, 1 other). 6 Discharging (1 scrap, 2 cars, 2 fertiliser, 1 pig-iron), no vessels anchored, no delays expected.

TURKEY, Feb 25 - Mersin - 23 Vessels in port operating of which 12 loading (1 flour, 1 carton, 2 legumes, 1 fruit, 2 glass, 1 bulk soda, 1 citrus, 1 vegetable oil, 1 livestock, 1 cement). 5 Discharging (1 sugar/pvc, 1 legumes, 1 bulk sulphuric acid, 1 vehicles). 6 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 3 containers,general cargo, 1 containers, 1 machinery/general cargo/legumes). 15 Vessels awaiting orders. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel loading sugar. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE Feb 24 - Mariupol - Six vessels loading at berth (2 metal products, 2 sulphur, 1 coal, 1 fertiliser), 1 alumina vessel discharging at berth. 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 sulphur, 1 sunflower seeds). 12 Floating storehouses (2 sulphur, 10 fertiliser). 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked. 23 Vessels due of which 9 to discharge (6 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 oranges), 1 to discharge chrome ore/load metal products. 13 To load (3 coal, 4 sulphur, 3 metal products, 1 clay, 2 fertiliser).

Kerch - One vessel berthed loading metal products, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 3 due of which 2 to load (1 glass, 1 metal products). 1 To discharge manganese ore. Berdyansk - Four vessels loading at berth (2 sunflower seeds, 1 metal products, 1 coal). 1 Discharging oranges at berth. Odessa - 14 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (3 metal, 1 chemicals, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 oil). 1 Discharging citrus, 2 under repair, 3 passenger vessels, 1 technical and food supply vessel. 1 Vessel waiting, 4 waiting in roads, all to load (3 sun flower seeds, 1 oil). 18 Vessels due of which 12 to load (2 chemicals, 1 peas, 6 metal, 2 sunflower seeds, 1 fertiliser). 5 To discharge (4 citrus, 1 bananas), 1 to discharge/load containers.

Mariupol - Five vessels in port operating of which 4 loading (1 pipes, 2 fertiliser, 1 slabs). 1 Discharging alumina, 2 vessels waiting in roads, both to load, of which 1 sunflower seed, 1 sulphur. 22 Vessels due of which 12 to load (3 coal, 6 fertiliser, 3 steel). 2 To discharge (1 equipment, 1 citrus), 1 to discharge/load chrome ore/steel. 7 To discharge/load containers.

YUGOSLAVIA, Feb 25 - Bar - Seven vessels berthed of which 3 discharging bananas, 4 loading (2 steel coils, 2 aluminium), 5 ferries on t lines. Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Bar - No delays. Zelenika, Bijela - One vessel discharging diesel oil, 3 vessels laid up, 3 under repair.
